conventions.coupling: physical time frame/fps+0.02, preparation 1.1..1.38 s; COM from measured masses/local COMs, relative to wheel midpoint in yaw lateral axis
conventions.episodes: includes truncated sixth cycle for peaks and windows if covered; successes count only terminal motion_finished without other causes
conventions.height_roll: post-physics state labeled with commanded reference frame/fps; jump window 1.1..1.7 s, landing 1.45..1.9 s
conventions.joint_loads: 5ms physics samples, configured nominal speed limits and actuator effort limits; no hardware acceptance claim
conventions.mirror: shared old/new nominal observation sets; each model validated against its own recorded mean action; randomized diagnosis is separate noise-free nominal-default probe
conventions.unloading: physical substep time; first 15ms all eight monitored contacts below 1/10/20 N in 1.15..1.6 s; final wheel unloading before it; not proof every robot contact absent

limitations: One environment and seed42 per case; startup physical parameters fixed across repeated episodes
Mirror behavior and dynamics improvement are distinct; new training run adds height reward; single independently trained pair does not establish robust causal attribution
No approved convergence thresholds or hardware validation
